messages:
elena: Quick request for runtime — we need a tiny reproducible bench bundle for the launch slide and webinar. Heatmap (coldstart vs steady), 50/95/99 per-request latencies, tokens/sec and $/1k for fp16 vs int8. Keep it minimal.

matt: Which model + matrix?

elena: redwood/3b-compat-v1. Batch 1 & 8, conc 1 & 16, seqlens 32/192/1024. Per-request percentiles.

sophie: Include raw token counts and env (CUDA/driver/kernel commit). One PNG + CSV + 2-sentence caveats. Deadline Thu 18:00 PT.

andy: Plan: 2 warmups, 100 samples per cell, collect 50/95/99, GPU util, and stderr on kernel warnings. We'll upload artifacts and a short README.

elena: Sample prompts: https://gist.example.com/redwood/webinar-samples (use "webinar-clean").

matt: We'll capture commit hash and kernel selection. If int8 is unstable at 1024, we'll flag the cell and include stderr.

andy: Repro snippet well attach:
```
curl -sS -X POST https://runtime.internal.redwood/api/v1/generate \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $RUNTIME_TOKEN' \\
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\
  -d '{"model":"redwood/3b-compat-v1","input":"<sample>","max_tokens":64,"batch":1}'
```

runtime-bot: Job queued: run_id=job-2026-1755-01, logs: /internal/bench/runs/job-2026-1755-01

and: Will try to have artifacts Wed night. If things fail, we'll provide conservative phrasing for marketing.

elena: Thanks — please @matt @andy for updates.
